europe_now.title: French Authorities Investigate Train Derailment for Sabotage
europe_now.summary: French law enforcement officials are actively probing whether a malicious act caused a recent train derailment in Normandy. Security agencies are examining the site as part of the ongoing inquiry into the transit disruption.

sources.headline: French police suspect train derailment was sabotage
French officials investigate if malicious act caused train derailment

europe_now.title: German Protests Emerge Following Far-Right AfD Success
europe_now.summary: Large crowds of demonstrators have gathered across Germany to protest the recent political gains made by the far-right Alternative for Germany party. The demonstrations follow regional election results that placed the party ahead in eastern states.

sources.headline: Tens of thousands protest against far-right AfD party in Germany
Germany: Protests follow AfD election victory

top_stories.title: Donald Trump Visits Ireland for Political Talks
top_stories.summary: Donald Trump has traveled to Dublin for official discussions with Irish leaders before heading to his property in Doonbeg. During the visit, he remarked to reporters that he would favor the prospect of a unified Ireland.

sources.headline: Trump begins two-day Ireland visit, security operation costs €20 million
A united Ireland would be 'fantastic' says Trump during Irish visit

top_stories.title: Substantial Financial Donations to UK Political Party
top_stories.summary: Reform UK has secured significant multi-million pound financial contributions from a prominent crypto billionaire. The massive funding boost arrives amid ongoing debates surrounding political donations and electoral financing dynamics in the United Kingdom.
